I answered Dana in a thread on their #north-team message: the hub replacement at Zoom Room B is IT ticket **#4092**.

The number comes from Ilse in #north-random on Oct 13 at 11:55. Dana is a member of that channel. Ilse also warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom, so I included that in the reply.

Dana had told me in a direct message that they guess the ticket will end up as OPS-5546 next year, and asked me to keep it private. That's only a guess, not the real ticket, and I didn't mention it in the channel. Nothing needed approval.
